subject: Request: Combined credits + discount for Highland Systems — trial extension
messages:
From: Samantha Ortega <samantha.ortega@highlandsys.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@highlandsys.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: trial extension + combined credits/discount option

Hi Vanessa / Ben —

Thanks again for the pilot support to date. Highland Systems has been running several end-to-end experiments on the Redwood API and we see good signal on accuracy for our document extraction + summarization flows. Usage spiked this week during the scale test (attached usage excerpt).

We have two asks to keep momentum and finalize procurement this quarter:
- Trial extension: we need an additional 30 days to complete regression tests across our EU cluster.
- Combined commercial concession: would Redwood consider a one-time credit top-up plus a promotional discount for the first paid quarter? Specifically, our procurement team is asking whether you could do ~30k in free credits and a 25% introductory discount on list prices for Q3.

These concessions are important for our board timing — we are lining up the PO and legal review but need firm economics to proceed. Happy to hop on a quick call to align.

Attachments: Highland-usage-report.csv (summary)

Thanks,
Samantha Ortega
Head of ML Product
Highland Systems
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Ortega <samantha.ortega@highlandsys.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: trial extension + combined credits/discount option

Samantha —

Really appreciate the update and the usage detail. Quick note: we can extend the trial window while we work internal approvals, but the combined credit + discount ask requires exec signoff from our pricing committee. I’m looping in Ben for a proposed package and Marissa for visibility (exec).

Next steps I suggest:
1) Ben to draft the proposed concession package with clear economics and success criteria.
2) We’ll escalate to pricing + finance for fast-track review.
3) If approved, Legal will prepare a short amendment (DocuSign) to attach to the PO.

I’ll provision a 30-day extension today so you don’t lose momentum.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Highland Systems — proposed concession package for exec review

Team —

Summary of ask from Highland (Samantha / Carlos): 30k one-time credit top-up + 25% discount for first paid quarter; 30-day trial extension (vanessa has provisioned). Economics (rough):
- Expected MRR after conversion: $45k
- First-quarter ARR impact w/ discount: ~$101k vs list ~$134k
- Estimated payback on credits: 3–4 months given current forecasted usage

Proposal for fast-track approval:
Option A (aggressive — recommended for conversion): 30k credits + 25% discount for Q1, 30-day extension, contingent on signed PO within 14 days and SOC2 attestation provided.
Option B (compromise — lower exposure): 20k credits + 20% discount for Q1, 15-day extension, PO within 21 days.

Attachments: deal_summary.pdf, pricing_model.xlsx

Requesting exec signoff on Option B or permission to offer Option A for Marissa's discretion. If approved, legal will send a short amendment for signature.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Highland Systems — proposed concession package for exec review

Ben / Vanessa —

Thanks for the concise options. I’m inclined to approve Option B today with a small addendum: approve 22k credits + 20% discount for the first paid quarter and a 15-day extension (halfway between A/B). Conditions:
1) PO received within 21 days of this approval.
2) Security must confirm we have the supplemental evidence (SOC2 + data retention matrix) before the credits are applied.
3) This is a one-time, non-recurring concession tied to the specified deal id (DEAL-87942).

If you need additional flexibility (Option A), escalate to CFO; I will not sign above the revised numbers without CFO review. Ben — please prepare the amendment and loop Legal (Megan Liu) for a streamlined DocuSign.

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

Thank you — Option B (as revised by Marissa: 22k credits + 20% discount + 15-day extension) is acceptable to Highland. We will aim to have a PO executed within the 21-day window. Megan from VentureLaw (cc’d) will coordinate with your legal team on the amendment.
